```{r setup}
#| include: false

# All data loaded from pre-computed targets via tar_load().
# MANDATORY: Uses FULL historical data (2019-2026), never sampled.
library(targets)

store_path <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "_targets" else "../_targets"
targets::tar_config_set(store = store_path)

not_available_msg <- function(target_name) {
  htmltools::div(
    class = "alert alert-warning",
    htmltools::h4("Data Not Available"),
    htmltools::p(
      "The ", htmltools::code(target_name), " target has not been built."
    ),
    htmltools::p("Run ", htmltools::code("targets::tar_make()"), " to generate.")
  )
}

tryCatch({
  tar_load(telemetry_summary)
  tar_load(telemetry_station_coverage)
  tar_load(telemetry_db_info)
  tar_load(telemetry_db_file_size)
  tar_load(telemetry_data_freshness)
  tar_load(telemetry_pipeline_status)
  tar_load(telemetry_qc_trends)
  tar_load(telemetry_rogue_frequency)
  tar_load(telemetry_git_commits)
  tar_load(telemetry_commit_frequency)
  tar_load(telemetry_file_types)

  tar_load(table_telemetry_station_coverage)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_db_info)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_freshness)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_commits)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_file_types)
  tar_load(telemetry_target_metrics)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_target_metrics)

  tar_load(telemetry_test_stats)
  tar_load(telemetry_test_summary)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_test_stats)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_test_summary)

  tar_load(telemetry_llm_sessions)
  tar_load(telemetry_llm_daily)
  tar_load(telemetry_llm_summary)
  tar_load(telemetry_llm_by_model)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_llm_cost_trend)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_llm_tokens)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_llm_by_model)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_llm_summary)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_llm_daily)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_llm_by_model)

  tar_load(plot_telemetry_coverage_timeline)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_qc_trends)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_rogue_frequency)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_commit_frequency)

  tar_load(telemetry_commit_velocity)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_commit_velocity)
  tar_load(plot_telemetry_commit_velocity)
  tar_load(telemetry_github_activity)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_github_activity)
  tar_load(telemetry_codebase_metrics)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_codebase_metrics)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_top_size)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_top_time)
  tar_load(table_telemetry_ci_workflows)

  targets_loaded <- TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  targets_loaded <<- FALSE
})
```

## Overview {#overview}

Project health and data pipeline metrics for the irishbuoys package.

### Key Metrics {#key-metrics}

```{r}
if (exists("telemetry_summary") && !is.null(telemetry_summary)) {
  metrics <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total Observations", "Database Size", "Active Stations",
               "Commits (30d)", "Last Updated", "Date Range"),
    Value = c(
      format(telemetry_summary$total_observations, big.mark = ","),
      paste0(telemetry_summary$db_size_mb, " MB"),
      as.character(telemetry_summary$stations_active),
      as.character(telemetry_summary$n_commits_30d),
      format(telemetry_summary$generated_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"),
      paste("2019-01-01 to", format(Sys.Date()))
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(metrics, align = c("l", "r"))
} else {
  not_available_msg("telemetry_summary")
}
```

  df <- telemetry_db_file_size
  storage <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("File", "Size", "Last Modified"),
    Value = c(df$path, paste0(df$size_mb, " MB"),
              format(df$last_modified, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(storage, align = c("l", "r"))
} else {
  not_available_msg("telemetry_db_file_size")
}

## Pipeline {#pipeline}

Targets pipeline status, timing metrics, and execution history.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Execution Status {#target-status}

```{r}
if (exists("telemetry_pipeline_status") && !is.null(telemetry_pipeline_status$status_summary)) {
  DT::datatable(telemetry_pipeline_status$status_summary,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv", "excel", "print"),
                   pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE, class = "display compact"
  )
} else {
  not_available_msg("telemetry_pipeline_status")
}
```

### Performance {#timing-metrics}

```{r}
if (exists("telemetry_pipeline_status") && !is.null(telemetry_pipeline_status$timing)) {
  timing <- telemetry_pipeline_status$timing
  perf <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total runtime", "Average per target", "Slowest target", "Last run"),
    Value = c(
      paste(round(timing$total_runtime_sec, 1), "seconds"),
      paste(round(timing$avg_runtime_sec, 2), "seconds"),
      paste(round(timing$max_runtime_sec, 1), "seconds"),
      format(timing$last_run, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(perf, align = c("l", "r"))
} else {
  not_available_msg("telemetry_pipeline_status")
}
```

### Test Types {#test-types}

| Category | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Unit Tests | Standard `test_that()` blocks testing individual functions |
| Adversarial/Edge Cases | Tests for NULL, NA, empty inputs, boundary conditions |
| Defensive/Null Guards | Tests verifying `cli::cli_abort()` on invalid inputs |
| Contains Snapshots | Files with `expect_snapshot()` calls |
| Integration Tests | End-to-end tests spanning multiple components |

:::

### Pricing Reference {#pricing-reference}

| Model | Input | Output | Cache Create | Cache Read |
|-------|-------|--------|--------------|------------|
| Opus 4.5 | $15/M | $75/M | $18.75/M | $1.875/M |
| Sonnet 4 | $3/M | $15/M | $3.75/M | $0.375/M |
| Haiku 3.5 | $0.80/M | $4/M | $1/M | $0.08/M |

Data source: Claude Code session files in `~/.claude/projects/`.

:::
